mod.name: NoFertilizer
mod.author: kjscott27
kJs-
mod.description:
Allows crops to grow without fertilizer at 50% growth rate. You can access the toggle when selecting a grow bed, the toggle is at the bottom of the screen with the other logistics options.
If fertilizer is available it will still be consumed to return the plant growth back to 100% (or more as intended by your research bonuses). Additionally, when the toggle is on it will hide any in game notifications for missing Fertilizer during the growth of your plants.
